description.en: Initializes the "HQ event" system for a high-quality scripted cutscene, before registering the handles and lighting/visibility steps it will drive with CMND_REG_HDL_HQ_EVENT, CMND_REG_MAP_LIGHT_HQ_EVENT and CMND_REG_VISIBLE_HQ_EVENT.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Start setting up a high-quality scripted cutscene
CMND_HQ_EVENT_INIT();
